description: A woman with dark hair pinned up, in a dark high-necked dress with a white collar, sits at a wooden table writing with a quill pen by candlelight. A lit candle in a brass holder, several inkwells, loose handwritten pages and leather-bound books are on the table; a bookshelf and a fireplace fill the dim room behind her, with a dark-paned window on the right. Era cues: quill and inkwells, candle light, a high-collared 19th-century-style dress. The pages carry rows of scribbled, handwriting-like marks, not readable letters. The painting runs edge to edge in an oil-painting style with no frame or border.
